comparison.objective: Press a springing picture-frame back flush while rotating four retaining clips, swapping hands.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-and-actuate coordination, hand swapping, and repeated small rotary manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: All four clips rotated at least 80°, back seated within pose tolerances, hands released and arms returned, stable for one second.
comparison.reason: Repeated bimanual stabilization is shared only generically. Clip rotation against a spring does not test coaxial mandrel seating, controlled hammer impact, material separation at a notch, or loose-fragment recovery.
